```{r paths, include = FALSE}
# ---- Project folder: every path below is built from here ----
project_root <- "C:/Users/DeniciaAragon/OneDrive - Healogix/Q4_3_Pulse"
proj <- function(...) file.path(project_root, ...)
if (!dir.exists(project_root)) stop("Project folder not found: ", project_root)

# ---- Find an input file anywhere inside the project folder ----
# Looks in data/processed first, then searches every subfolder for the same file name,
# so the script still runs if the data sit in a different folder.
find_in <- function(name) {
  first <- proj("data", "processed", name)
  if (file.exists(first)) return(first)
  hits <- list.files(project_root, pattern = paste0("^", gsub(".", "\\.", name, fixed = TRUE), "$"),
                     recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- hits[!grepl("/output/", hits)]
  if (length(hits) > 0) return(hits[1])
  first
}
```

```{r settings, include = FALSE}
MIN_GROUP_N <- 5        # a comparison is tested only when every group has at least this many people
N_BOOT      <- 2000     # bootstrap resamples for confidence intervals
HOVER_CHARS <- 220      # how much of each participant's text to show on hover
CALMER_CUT  <- 5        # a drop of at least this many negative-affect points counts as "calmer"
set.seed(2026)

# Healogix: as blue as possible; the negative end of a scale may be non-blue
GROUP_COLORS  <- list(`2` = c("#1F4E79", "#9DC3E6"), `3` = c("#1F4E79", "#4A86C5", "#9DC3E6"))
GROUP_SYMBOLS <- c("circle", "square", "diamond")
NEG_COLOR <- "#E3A26F"; GRAY <- "#C9CED6"
INK <- "#1A1A1A"; MUTED <- "#5F6B7A"

PA_ITEMS <- c("interested", "excited", "strong", "enthusiastic", "proud",
              "alert", "inspired", "determined", "attentive", "active")
NA_ITEMS <- c("distressed", "upset", "guilty", "scared", "hostile",
              "irritable", "ashamed", "nervous", "jittery", "afraid")
```

```{r ids, include = FALSE}
# ---- Participant IDs ----------------------------------------------------------
# Every data frame in this script carries all three IDs: pid, response_id and prolific_id.
# The IDs are attached here, in memory only. They are not written to any file and not shown in the report.
ID_COLS <- c("pid", "response_id", "prolific_id")

# Standardize header names and the names of the three ID columns, whatever each file calls them
clean_ids <- function(d) {
  names(d) <- trimws(gsub("^\ufeff", "", names(d)))
  low <- tolower(names(d))
  rename_first <- function(d, idx, new) { if (length(idx) && !(new %in% names(d))) names(d)[idx[1]] <- new; d }
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low == "pid"), "pid")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("response_id", "response id", "responseid")), "response_id")
  d <- rename_first(d, which(low %in% c("prolific_id", "prolific_pid", "prolificid", "url variable: prolific_pid")), "prolific_id")
  d |> mutate(across(any_of(ID_COLS), \(x) trimws(as.character(x))))
}
read_chr <- function(f) read_csv(f, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = c("", "NA")) |> clean_ids()

# Crosswalk: pid <-> prolific_id from the link file, then response_id matched on prolific_id from the 00 renamed file
ids <- if (file.exists(in_link)) read_chr(in_link) |> select(any_of(ID_COLS)) |> distinct() else tibble(pid = character())
for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(ids)) ids[[col]] <- NA_character_
if (file.exists(in_ids)) {
  rn <- read_chr(in_ids) |> select(any_of(c("response_id", "prolific_id")))
  if (all(c("response_id", "prolific_id") %in% names(rn))) {
    rn <- rn |> filter(!is.na(prolific_id), !duplicated(prolific_id))
    ids$response_id <- coalesce(ids$response_id, rn$response_id[match(ids$prolific_id, rn$prolific_id)])
  }
}
ids <- ids |> select(all_of(ID_COLS))

# Give any data frame all three IDs, filling the missing ones from whichever ID it already has
add_ids <- function(d) {
  d <- clean_ids(d)
  for (col in ID_COLS) if (!col %in% names(d)) d[[col]] <- NA_character_
  for (key in ID_COLS) {
    lk <- ids[!is.na(ids[[key]]) & !duplicated(ids[[key]]), ]
    m <- match(d[[key]], lk[[key]])
    for (other in setdiff(ID_COLS, key)) d[[other]] <- coalesce(d[[other]], lk[[other]][m])
  }
  if (all(is.na(d$pid))) stop("Could not find or match a pid for this data. Check the ID columns in the input files.")
  d |> relocate(all_of(ID_COLS))
}
```

```{r load-and-score, include = FALSE}
d05   <- read_chr(in_05) |> add_ids()
codes <- read_chr(in_codes) |> add_ids()

CODE_BIN <- c("convo_usable", "human_mentions_disease", "human_shares_personal", "human_asks_med", "human_multi_turn",
              "human_1_long", "ai_multi_med", "ai_recommends_med", "ai_refers_professional", "ai_urgent_care",
              "ai_followup_question", "ai_disclaimer")
CODE_NUM <- c("ai_n_meds", "human_1_n_words_coded", "n_human_turns", "ai_total_words")
codes <- codes |> mutate(across(any_of(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM)), as.numeric))

# PANAS answers may export as numbers or as labels; both become 1-5
PANAS_LABELS <- c("very slightly or not at all" = 1, "a little" = 2, "moderately" = 3, "quite a bit" = 4, "extremely" = 5)
to_panas <- function(x) {
  t <- trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(t, "^[1-5](?![0-9])")))
  ifelse(!is.na(num), num, unname(PANAS_LABELS[t]))
}
# Items 1-5 were exported twice; use the main copy and fill any gaps from the *_dup copy
panas <- d05 |> select(all_of(ID_COLS))
for (wave in c("pre", "post")) for (item in c(PA_ITEMS, NA_ITEMS)) {
  main <- paste0("panas_", wave, "_", item); dup <- paste0(main, "_dup")
  v <- to_panas(d05[[main]])
  if (dup %in% names(d05)) v <- coalesce(v, to_panas(d05[[dup]]))
  panas[[main]] <- v
}
score <- function(wave, items) {
  m <- as.matrix(panas[paste0("panas_", wave, "_", items)])
  ifelse(rowSums(is.na(m)) == 0, rowSums(m), NA_real_)   # complete answers only
}
panas <- panas |> mutate(pa_pre = score("pre", PA_ITEMS), pa_post = score("post", PA_ITEMS),
                         na_pre = score("pre", NA_ITEMS), na_post = score("post", NA_ITEMS))

# ---- Goal achievement: hand-coded from convo_goal_met_oe ----
if (!file.exists(goal_file)) {
  template <- d05 |> transmute(pid, convo_goal_met_oe, goal_met = "", goal_reason = "", coder_notes = "")
  wb <- createWorkbook(); addWorksheet(wb, "goal_coding")
  writeData(wb, "goal_coding", template, headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold"))
  dataValidation(wb, "goal_coding", cols = 3, rows = 2:(nrow(template) + 1), type = "list", value = '"Yes,Partly,No"')
  setColWidths(wb, "goal_coding", cols = 1:5, widths = c(8, 80, 12, 30, 30))
  addStyle(wb, "goal_coding", createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top"), rows = 2:(nrow(template) + 1), cols = 2, gridExpand = TRUE)
  freezePane(wb, "goal_coding", firstRow = TRUE)
  saveWorkbook(wb, goal_file)
}
goal <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(goal_file, sheet = 1) |> add_ids() |>
  mutate(goal_met = str_to_title(trimws(as.character(goal_met))),
         goal_met = ifelse(goal_met %in% c("Yes", "Partly", "No"), goal_met, NA)) |>
  select(all_of(ID_COLS), goal_met, any_of("goal_reason"))
goal_coded <- any(!is.na(goal$goal_met))

SURVEY_COLS <- c("convo_goal_met_oe", "convo_about", "detail_topic", "detail_duration_self", "detail_duration_other",
                 "detail_prior_knowledge", "detail_chatbot", "detail_months_ago", "action_ai_rec_self",
                 "action_ai_rec_other", "med_mentioned", "med_alternatives", "med_framing")
dat <- codes |>
  select(all_of(ID_COLS), human_1, any_of(c(CODE_BIN, CODE_NUM)), any_of(c("human_first_intent", "disease_terms", "ai_meds_named"))) |>
  left_join(d05 |> select(pid, any_of(SURVEY_COLS)), by = "pid") |>
  left_join(panas |> select(pid, pa_pre, pa_post, na_pre, na_post), by = "pid") |>
  left_join(goal |> select(-response_id, -prolific_id), by = "pid") |>
  mutate(goal_met = factor(goal_met, levels = c("Yes", "Partly", "No")),
         goal_met_yes = ifelse(is.na(goal_met), NA, as.integer(goal_met == "Yes")),
```

```{r segments, include = FALSE}
lc <- function(x) trimws(tolower(as.character(x)))
bin_lab <- function(x, lab1, lab0) factor(ifelse(x == 1, lab1, ifelse(x == 0, lab0, NA)), levels = c(lab1, lab0))

recode_intent <- function(x) factor(case_when(
  x == "symptom_interpretation" ~ "Symptom interpretation",
  x == "self_management" ~ "Self-management",
  x %in% c("condition_info", "medication_info", "care_decision", "other") ~ "Other questions",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Symptom interpretation", "Self-management", "Other questions"))
recode_topic <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t == "3" | str_detect(t, "specific diagnosed") ~ "Diagnosed condition",
  t == "2" | str_detect(t, "not been diagnosed|symptom") ~ "Undiagnosed symptom",
  t %in% c("1", "4") | str_detect(t, "general health|wellness|medication or treatment") ~ "General wellness or medication",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Diagnosed condition", "Undiagnosed symptom", "General wellness or medication")) }
recode_duration <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "less than a week|1 to 4 weeks") ~ "Under a month",
  t %in% c("3", "4", "5", "6") | str_detect(t, "month|year") ~ "A month or longer",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Under a month", "A month or longer")) }
recode_prior <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "nothing at all|^a little") ~ "Nothing or a little",
  t %in% c("3", "4", "5") | str_detect(t, "moderate|a lot|great deal") ~ "Moderate or more",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Nothing or a little", "Moderate or more")) }
recode_chatbot <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t == "1" | str_detect(t, "chatgpt") ~ "ChatGPT",
  t == "99" | str_detect(t, "remember") ~ NA_character_,
  !is.na(t) & t != "" ~ "Other chatbot",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("ChatGPT", "Other chatbot")) }

seg <- function(category, tab, group, desc) list(category = category, tab = tab, group = group, desc = desc)
P <- "What the participant wrote"; A <- "How the AI responded"; S <- "About the chat (survey)"
SEGMENTS <- list(
  seg(P, "Named a disease", bin_lab(dat$human_mentions_disease, "Named a disease", "No disease named"),
      "Whether the participant named a disease or condition in any of their messages (`human_mentions_disease`, hand-coded)."),
  seg(P, "Shared personal details", bin_lab(dat$human_shares_personal, "Shared personal details", "General questions only"),
      "Whether the participant described a specific real situation, such as symptoms, history or test results (`human_shares_personal`)."),
  seg(P, "Asked about a medication", bin_lab(dat$human_asks_med, "Asked about a medication", "Did not ask about one"),
      "Whether the participant asked about or named a specific medication (`human_asks_med`)."),
  seg(P, "First message intent", recode_intent(dat$human_first_intent),
      "Main purpose of the first message (`human_first_intent`). Condition information, medication information, care decisions and other are combined as \"Other questions\" because each is small."),
  seg(P, "Number of turns", bin_lab(dat$human_multi_turn, "More than one turn", "One turn"),
      "Whether the participant wrote more than one message (`human_multi_turn`)."),
  seg(P, "First message length", bin_lab(dat$human_1_long, "Longer first message", "Shorter first message"),
      "Whether the first message was above the median word count (`human_1_long`)."),
  seg(A, "AI medications", bin_lab(dat$ai_multi_med, "AI named 2+ medications", "AI named one medication"),
      "Among conversations where the AI named any medication, whether it named more than one (`ai_multi_med`). Vitamins and supplements are not counted."),
  seg(A, "AI recommended a medication", bin_lab(dat$ai_recommends_med, "AI recommended a medication", "Did not recommend one"),
      "Whether the AI suggested taking or trying a specific medication, as opposed to only mentioning one (`ai_recommends_med`)."),
  seg(A, "Referred to a professional", bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "Referred to a professional", "No referral"),
      "Whether the AI advised seeing or talking to a doctor, pharmacist or other provider (`ai_refers_professional`)."),
  seg(A, "Urgent care advice", bin_lab(dat$ai_urgent_care, "Mentioned urgent or emergency care", "Did not"),
      "Whether the AI mentioned urgent care, the ER, emergency care or 911 (`ai_urgent_care`)."),
  seg(A, "Asked a follow-up question", bin_lab(dat$ai_followup_question, "AI asked a follow-up question", "No follow-up question"),
      "Whether the AI asked the participant a clarifying question about their situation; offers of more help do not count (`ai_followup_question`)."),
  seg(A, "Included a disclaimer", bin_lab(dat$ai_disclaimer, "Included a disclaimer", "No disclaimer"),
      "Whether the AI said it is not a doctor or that its answer is not medical advice (`ai_disclaimer`)."),
  seg(S, "Topic", recode_topic(dat$detail_topic),
      "What the conversation was about (`detail_topic`). \"Something else\" answers are left out."),
  seg(S, "Condition duration", recode_duration(coalesce(dat$detail_duration_self, dat$detail_duration_other)),
      "How long the condition had lasted (`detail_duration_self` / `_other`). \"Not sure\" answers are left out."),
  seg(S, "Prior knowledge", recode_prior(dat$detail_prior_knowledge),
      "How much the participant knew about the condition before the chat (`detail_prior_knowledge`)."),
  seg(S, "Chatbot", recode_chatbot(dat$detail_chatbot),
      "Which chatbot the participant used (`detail_chatbot`). \"I don't remember\" answers are left out.")
)
CATEGORIES <- unique(vapply(SEGMENTS, `[[`, "", "category"))
GOAL_GROUP <- factor(ifelse(dat$goal_met_yes == 1, "Goal met", ifelse(dat$goal_met_yes == 0, "Goal not fully met", NA)),
                     levels = c("Goal met", "Goal not fully met"))
CALMER <- factor(case_when(dat$na_change <= -CALMER_CUT ~ "Calmer",
                           dat$na_change >= CALMER_CUT ~ "More distressed",
                           !is.na(dat$na_change) ~ "About the same"),
                 levels = c("Calmer", "About the same", "More distressed"))
```

```{r stats-functions, include = FALSE}
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a)) b else a
fmt  <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
fmts <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "NA", sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x))
fmtp <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))))
safe <- function(expr) tryCatch(expr, error = function(e) NULL)

boot_ci <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 2) return(c(NA, NA))
  quantile(replicate(N_BOOT, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE))), c(.025, .975), names = FALSE)
}
boot_diff_ci <- function(x, y) {
  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(c(NA, NA))
  quantile(replicate(N_BOOT, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE)) - mean(sample(y, replace = TRUE))), c(.025, .975), names = FALSE)
}
rb_paired <- function(d) { d <- d[d != 0]; if (!length(d)) return(NA); r <- rank(abs(d)); (sum(r[d > 0]) - sum(r[d < 0])) / sum(r) }

wrap_html <- function(x, n = HOVER_CHARS) {
  x <- ifelse(is.na(x) | trimws(x) == "", "(no text)", x)
  x <- ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n), "..."), x)
  unname(vapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(htmltools::htmlEscape(s), 60), collapse = "<br>"), character(1)))
}
group_cols <- function(k) if (k <= 2) GROUP_COLORS[["2"]][seq_len(k)] else GROUP_COLORS[["3"]][seq_len(k)]
plot_title <- function(title, subtitle) list(
  text = paste0("<b>", paste(strwrap(title, 80), collapse = "<br>"), "</b><br><span style='font-size:12px;color:", MUTED, "'>",
                paste(strwrap(subtitle, 120), collapse = "<br>"), "</span>"),
  x = 0, xanchor = "left", font = list(size = 16, color = INK))
base_layout <- function(p, title, subtitle, ...) p |> layout(
  title = plot_title(title, subtitle), margin = list(t = 120, l = 60),
  hoverlabel = list(align = "left", bgcolor = "white", font = list(color = INK)),
  plot_bgcolor = "white", paper_bgcolor = "white", ...) |> config(displaylogo = FALSE)
# Participant hover text: pid, the line that matters for this chart, first message and goal answer
person_hover <- function(d, group_label, line) paste0(
  "<b>pid ", d$pid, "</b> | ", htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(group_label)), "<br>", line,
  "<br><br><b>First message</b><br>", wrap_html(d$human_1),
  "<br><br><b>Goal met?</b> ", ifelse(is.na(d$goal_met), "not coded", as.character(d$goal_met)),
  "<br>", wrap_html(d$convo_goal_met_oe))

# ---- Emotion score (PA or NA): change within each group and difference between groups ----
emotion_stats <- function(group, pre, post) {
  pre_vals <- dat[[pre]]; post_vals <- dat[[post]]
  d <- dat |> mutate(group = group, pre = pre_vals, post = post_vals, change = post - pre) |>
    filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |> mutate(group = droplevels(group))
  by <- d |> group_by(group) |> summarise(
    n = n(), mean_pre = mean(pre), mean_post = mean(post), mean_change = mean(change), ci = list(boot_ci(change)),
    p_within = if (n() >= MIN_GROUP_N) safe(wilcox.test(post, pre, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value) %||% NA_real_ else NA_real_,
    r_within = rb_paired(change), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(ci_lo = vapply(ci, `[`, numeric(1), 1), ci_hi = vapply(ci, `[`, numeric(1), 2)) |> select(-ci)
  k <- nrow(by); testable <- k >= 2 && all(by$n >= MIN_GROUP_N)
  out <- list(data = d, by = by, k = k, testable = testable, p = NA, p_adj = NA, eff = NA, eff_name = "", test = "")
  if (testable && k == 2) {
    x <- d$change[d$group == by$group[1]]; y <- d$change[d$group == by$group[2]]
    w <- safe(wilcox.test(x, y, exact = FALSE))
    out <- modifyList(out, list(p = w$p.value %||% NA, test = "Mann-Whitney", eff_name = "rank-biserial r",
                                eff = if (!is.null(w)) 2 * w$statistic[[1]] / (length(x) * length(y)) - 1 else NA))
  } else if (testable) {
    kw <- safe(kruskal.test(change ~ group, data = d))
    out <- modifyList(out, list(p = kw$p.value %||% NA, test = "Kruskal-Wallis", eff_name = "epsilon-squared",
                                eff = if (!is.null(kw)) kw$statistic[[1]] / (nrow(d) - 1) else NA))
  }
  out
}

# ---- Item-level change (descriptive only) ----
item_stats <- function(group) {
  panas |> mutate(group = group[match(panas$pid, dat$pid)]) |> filter(!is.na(group)) |>
    pivot_longer(starts_with("panas_"), names_to = c("wave", "item"), names_pattern = "panas_(pre|post)_(.*)") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = wave, values_from = value) |> filter(!is.na(pre), !is.na(post)) |>
    group_by(group, item) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean_pre = mean(pre), mean_post = mean(post), mean_change = mean(post - pre), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(scale = ifelse(item %in% PA_ITEMS, "Positive", "Negative"), group = droplevels(group))
}

# ---- A category outcome (goal met, felt calmer, recall checks) by group ----
cat_stats <- function(group, cat, target) {
  d <- dat |> mutate(group = group, cat = cat) |> filter(!is.na(group), !is.na(cat)) |>
    mutate(group = droplevels(group), cat = droplevels(cat))
  by <- d |> group_by(group) |> summarise(n = n(), n_target = sum(cat == target), pct_target = 100 * mean(cat == target), .groups = "drop")
  k <- nrow(by); testable <- k >= 2 && all(by$n >= MIN_GROUP_N) && nlevels(d$cat) >= 2
  out <- list(data = d, by = by, k = k, testable = testable, target = target, p = NA, p_adj = NA)
  if (testable) {
    tab <- table(d$group, d$cat == target)
    out$p <- if (ncol(tab) == 2) safe(fisher.test(tab)$p.value) %||% NA else NA
  }
  out
}
```

```{r plot-functions, include = FALSE}
# ---- Before vs. after slope chart: one faint line per participant, a bold line per group mean ----
emotion_title <- function(st, label) {
  if (st$k < 2) return(paste0(label, ": only one group has data"))
  ch <- setNames(st$by$mean_change, st$by$group)
  if (st$k == 2) {
    a <- names(ch)[1]; b <- names(ch)[2]; ca <- ch[[1]]; cb <- ch[[2]]
    if (abs(ca - cb) < 0.5) return(paste0(label, " changed about the same for both groups (", fmts(ca), " vs. ", fmts(cb), ")"))
    big <- if (abs(ca) >= abs(cb)) a else b; small <- setdiff(c(a, b), big)
    if (sign(ca) == sign(cb) || ca == 0 || cb == 0) {
      verb <- if (ch[[big]] > 0) "rose" else "fell"
      return(paste0(label, " ", verb, " more for ", big, " (", fmts(ch[[big]]), ") than ", small, " (", fmts(ch[[small]]), ")"))
    }
    up <- names(ch)[ch > 0]; dn <- names(ch)[ch < 0]
    return(paste0(label, " rose for ", up, " (", fmts(ch[[up]]), ") but fell for ", dn, " (", fmts(ch[[dn]]), ")"))
  }
  paste0(label, " change: ", paste0(names(ch), " ", fmts(ch), collapse = ", "))
}
test_line <- function(st, test, extra = "", corrected = TRUE) {
  ns <- paste0("n = ", paste(st$by$n, collapse = " vs. "))
  if (!st$testable) return(paste0(ns, "  |  not tested: a group has fewer than ", MIN_GROUP_N, " people", extra))
  paste0(ns, "  |  ", test, " p = ", fmtp(st$p), if (corrected) paste0(" (BH-adjusted ", fmtp(st$p_adj), ")") else " (not corrected)", extra)
}

emotion_plot <- function(st, label) {
  d <- st$data; k <- st$k; cols <- group_cols(k); lv <- levels(d$group)
  sub <- test_line(st, st$test, paste0(if (st$testable) paste0(", ", st$eff_name, " = ", fmt(st$eff, 2)) else "", "  |  score range 10-50"))
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (i in seq_along(lv)) {
    g <- lv[i]; dg <- d[d$group == g, ]; off <- (i - (k + 1) / 2) * 0.07; s <- st$by[st$by$group == g, ]
    hv <- function(when, val) person_hover(dg, g, paste0(when, ": ", val, " (before ", dg$pre, ", after ", dg$post, ", change ", fmts(dg$change, 0), ")"))
    p <- p |> add_trace(
      x = as.vector(rbind(rep(0 + off, nrow(dg)), rep(1 + off, nrow(dg)), NA)), y = as.vector(rbind(dg$pre, dg$post, NA)),
      text = as.vector(rbind(hv("Before", dg$pre), hv("After", dg$post), NA)),
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", hoverinfo = "text", line = list(color = cols[i], width = 1), opacity = 0.35,
      marker = list(color = cols[i], size = 7, symbol = GROUP_SYMBOLS[i]), legendgroup = g, showlegend = FALSE, name = g)
    p <- p |> add_trace(
      x = c(0, 1) + off, y = c(s$mean_pre, s$mean_post), type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", hoverinfo = "text",
      text = paste0("<b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(g), "</b> (n = ", s$n, ")<br>Mean before: ", fmt(s$mean_pre), "<br>Mean after: ",
                    fmt(s$mean_post), "<br>Mean change: ", fmts(s$mean_change), " [95% CI ", fmts(s$ci_lo), ", ", fmts(s$ci_hi), "]"),
      line = list(color = cols[i], width = 4),
      marker = list(color = cols[i], size = 13, symbol = GROUP_SYMBOLS[i], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
      legendgroup = g, name = paste0(g, " (n = ", s$n, ")"))
  }
  base_layout(p, emotion_title(st, label), sub,
    xaxis = list(tickvals = c(0, 1), ticktext = c("Before the chat", "After the chat"), range = c(-0.35, 1.35),
                 title = "", zeroline = FALSE, showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = paste(label, "score"), range = c(9, 51), gridcolor = "#E6E9EE", zeroline = FALSE),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.12))
}

# ---- Item-level dot plot: mean change on each PANAS item, one dot per group ----
item_plot <- function(it) {
  lv <- levels(it$group); k <- length(lv); cols <- group_cols(k)
  ord <- it |> group_by(item, scale) |> summarise(m = mean(mean_change), .groups = "drop") |> arrange(scale, m)
  it <- it |> mutate(item = factor(item, levels = ord$item))
  gap <- it |> group_by(item) |> summarise(gap = diff(range(mean_change)), .groups = "drop") |> slice_max(gap, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  gi <- it |> filter(item == gap$item)
  title <- if (k < 2) "Item-level change: only one group has data" else
    paste0("Biggest group difference is on \"", gap$item, "\": ", paste0(gi$group, " ", fmts(gi$mean_change, 2), collapse = " vs. "))
  ns <- it |> group_by(group) |> summarise(n = max(n), .groups = "drop")
  sub <- paste0("Mean change on each PANAS item (after minus before, 1-5 scale)  |  n = ", paste(ns$n, collapse = " vs. "), "  |  descriptive only")
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (i in seq_along(lv)) {
    di <- it[it$group == lv[i], ]
    p <- p |> add_trace(
      data = di, x = ~mean_change, y = ~item, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", name = lv[i], hoverinfo = "text",
      marker = list(color = cols[i], size = 11, symbol = GROUP_SYMBOLS[i], line = list(color = "white", width = 1.5)),
      text = paste0("<b>", di$item, "</b> (", tolower(di$scale), " affect)<br>", htmltools::htmlEscape(lv[i]), " (n = ", di$n,
                    ")<br>Before: ", fmt(di$mean_pre, 2), "  |  After: ", fmt(di$mean_post, 2), "<br>Change: ", fmts(di$mean_change, 2)))
  }
  base_layout(p, title, sub,
    xaxis = list(title = "Mean change (after minus before)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#9AA3AF", gridcolor = "#E6E9EE"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = levels(it$item)),
    shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1, yref = "y", y0 = 9.5, y1 = 9.5,
                       line = list(color = GRAY, dash = "dot", width = 1))),
    annotations = list(
      list(text = "<b>Positive<br>affect items</b>", xref = "paper", x = 1.02, xanchor = "left", yref = "y", y = 14.5, showarrow = FALSE, align = "left", font = list(size = 11, color = MUTED)),
      list(text = "<b>Negative<br>affect items</b>", xref = "paper", x = 1.02, xanchor = "left", yref = "y", y = 4.5, showarrow = FALSE, align = "left", font = list(size = 11, color = MUTED))),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.1)) |>
    layout(margin = list(t = 120, l = 110, r = 110))
}

# ---- Unit chart: one square per participant, stacked by category within each group ----
UNIT_COLS <- 5   # squares per row within each group
unit_plot <- function(st, colors, legend_title, title, subtitle, top_label, hover_line) {
  # Squares fill each group's block left to right, bottom to top, ordered by category
  d <- st$data |> arrange(group, cat, pid) |> group_by(group) |>
    mutate(i = row_number() - 1, col = i %% UNIT_COLS, row = i %/% UNIT_COLS + 1) |> ungroup() |>
    mutate(x = as.integer(group) + (col - (UNIT_COLS - 1) / 2) * 0.13)
  max_rows <- max(ceiling(st$by$n / UNIT_COLS))
  p <- plot_ly()
  for (lvl in levels(d$cat)) {
    dl <- d[d$cat == lvl, ]; if (!nrow(dl)) next
    p <- p |> add_trace(x = dl$x, y = dl$row, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", name = lvl, hoverinfo = "text",
      marker = list(symbol = "square", size = 17, color = colors[[lvl]], line = list(color = "white", width = 2)),
      text = person_hover(dl, dl$group, hover_line(dl)))
  }
  ann <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(st$by)), function(i) list(x = i, y = ceiling(st$by$n[i] / UNIT_COLS) + 0.6, text = top_label(st$by[i, ]),
    showarrow = FALSE, yanchor = "bottom", font = list(size = 12, color = INK)))
  base_layout(p, title, subtitle,
    xaxis = list(tickvals = seq_len(st$k), ticktext = as.character(st$by$group), range = c(0.45, st$k + 0.55), title = "", showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", range = c(0.3, max_rows + 2.2), showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, showticklabels = FALSE),
    annotations = ann, legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.1, title = list(text = paste0(legend_title, "  ")))) |>
    layout(height = max(420, 170 + 34 * max_rows))
}
pct_title <- function(st, verb, fallback) {
  by <- st$by
  if (st$k < 2) return(paste0(fallback, ": only one group has data"))
  if (st$k == 2) return(paste0(round(by$pct_target[1]), "% of ", by$group[1], " ", verb, " vs. ", round(by$pct_target[2]), "% of ", by$group[2]))
  paste0(fallback, ": ", paste0(by$group, " ", round(by$pct_target), "%", collapse = ", "))
}

GOAL_COLORS   <- c(Yes = "#1F4E79", Partly = "#9DC3E6", No = NEG_COLOR)
CALMER_COLORS <- c(Calmer = "#1F4E79", `About the same` = "#9DC3E6", `More distressed` = NEG_COLOR)
goal_plot <- function(st) unit_plot(st, GOAL_COLORS, "Goal met?",
  pct_title(st, "felt their goal was met", "Goal met"), test_line(st, "Fisher's exact"),
  function(r) paste0("<b>", round(r$pct_target), "% met</b><br>n = ", r$n),
  function(d) paste0("Goal met? <b>", d$cat, "</b>", if ("goal_reason" %in% names(d)) ifelse(is.na(d$goal_reason), "", paste0(" | ", htmltools::htmlEscape(d$goal_reason))) else ""))
calmer_plot <- function(st) unit_plot(st, CALMER_COLORS, "After the chat",
  pct_title(st, "felt calmer after the chat", "Felt calmer"),
  test_line(st, "Fisher's exact (calmer vs. not)", paste0("  |  calmer = negative affect fell ", CALMER_CUT, "+ points")),
  function(r) paste0("<b>", round(r$pct_target), "% calmer</b><br>n = ", r$n),
  function(d) paste0("Negative affect: before ", d$na_pre, ", after ", d$na_post, " (change ", fmts(d$na_change, 0), ")"))

# ---- Summary tables under the charts ----
emotion_table <- function(st) st$by |> transmute(Group = group, n, `Mean before` = fmt(mean_pre), `Mean after` = fmt(mean_post),
  `Mean change [95% CI]` = paste0(fmts(mean_change), " [", fmts(ci_lo), ", ", fmts(ci_hi), "]"),
  `Within-group p (Wilcoxon)` = fmtp(p_within), `r (rank-biserial)` = fmt(r_within, 2)) |> kable(align = "lrrrrrr")
cat_table <- function(st) {
  tab <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(st$data$group, st$data$cat))
  tibble(Group = rownames(tab)) |> bind_cols(as_tibble(tab)) |>
    mutate(n = rowSums(tab), !!paste0("% ", st$target) := fmt(100 * tab[[st$target]] / rowSums(tab), 0)) |> kable()
}
```

```{r run-all, include = FALSE}
RES <- lapply(SEGMENTS, function(s) list(
  pa = emotion_stats(s$group, "pa_pre", "pa_post"),
  na = emotion_stats(s$group, "na_pre", "na_post"),
  calmer = cat_stats(s$group, CALMER, "Calmer"),
  items = item_stats(s$group),
  goal = if (goal_coded) cat_stats(s$group, dat$goal_met, "Yes") else NULL))

# Benjamini-Hochberg correction across all segments, within each outcome
for (key in c("pa", "na", "calmer", "goal")) {
  p <- vapply(RES, function(r) if (is.null(r[[key]])) NA_real_ else r[[key]]$p, numeric(1))
  pa <- rep(NA_real_, length(p)); ok <- !is.na(p); pa[ok] <- p.adjust(p[ok], "BH")
  for (i in seq_along(RES)) if (!is.null(RES[[i]][[key]])) RES[[i]][[key]]$p_adj <- pa[i]
}

GOAL_RES <- if (goal_coded) {
  r <- list(pa = emotion_stats(GOAL_GROUP, "pa_pre", "pa_post"), na = emotion_stats(GOAL_GROUP, "na_pre", "na_post"))
  r$pa$p_adj <- r$pa$p; r$na$p_adj <- r$na$p; r
} else NULL

all_comp <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(SEGMENTS), function(i) {
  r <- RES[[i]]
  row <- function(st, outcome, result, test) if (is.null(st)) NULL else tibble(
    Category = SEGMENTS[[i]]$category, Segment = SEGMENTS[[i]]$tab, Outcome = outcome, n = paste(st$by$n, collapse = " / "),
    Result = result, Test = if (st$testable) test else "not tested", p = st$p, p_BH = st$p_adj)
  bind_rows(
    row(r$pa, "Positive affect change", paste0(r$pa$by$group, " ", fmts(r$pa$by$mean_change), collapse = "; "), r$pa$test),
    row(r$na, "Negative affect change", paste0(r$na$by$group, " ", fmts(r$na$by$mean_change), collapse = "; "), r$na$test),
    row(r$calmer, "Felt calmer", paste0(r$calmer$by$group, " ", round(r$calmer$by$pct_target), "%", collapse = "; "), "Fisher's exact"),
    row(r$goal, "Goal met", if (!is.null(r$goal)) paste0(r$goal$by$group, " ", round(r$goal$by$pct_target), "%", collapse = "; "), "Fisher's exact"))
}))
openxlsx::write.xlsx(list(all_comparisons = all_comp), file.path(out_dir, "group-comparisons.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
```

All tests are exploratory. Each chart's title states the result; the line under it gives the group sizes, the test, and the p-value corrected for multiple comparisons (Benjamini-Hochberg, across all 16 segments within each outcome). Groups with fewer than `r MIN_GROUP_N` people are charted but not tested. Hover over any point or square to see that participant's first message and how they described whether their goal was met.

### Reliability

```{r reliability}
alpha <- function(wave, items) {
  m <- na.omit(as.matrix(panas[paste0("panas_", wave, "_", items)]))
  k <- ncol(m); if (nrow(m) < 3) return(c(NA, nrow(m)))
  c(k / (k - 1) * (1 - sum(apply(m, 2, var)) / var(rowSums(m))), nrow(m))
}
rel <- rbind(alpha("pre", PA_ITEMS), alpha("post", PA_ITEMS), alpha("pre", NA_ITEMS), alpha("post", NA_ITEMS))
tibble(Score = c("Positive affect, before", "Positive affect, after", "Negative affect, before", "Negative affect, after"),
       `Cronbach's alpha` = fmt(rel[, 1], 2), n = rel[, 2]) |> kable(align = "lrr")
```

PANAS items 1 to 5 were exported twice; the main copy is used, with any gaps filled from the duplicate copy. Scores are the sum of 10 items (range 10 to 50) and are only computed when all 10 items were answered.

### Group overlap

How strongly the segments go together (Cramér's V: 0 = unrelated, 1 = the same split). High values mean two tabs largely show the same people, so a difference that appears in both is one finding, not two.

```{r overlap}
seg_mat <- sapply(SEGMENTS, function(s) as.character(s$group))
cramers_v <- function(a, b) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b); if (sum(ok) < 5) return(NA)
  t <- table(a[ok], b[ok]); if (min(dim(t)) < 2) return(NA)
  chi <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(t, correct = FALSE)$statistic[[1]])
  sqrt(chi / (sum(t) * (min(dim(t)) - 1)))
}
labs <- vapply(SEGMENTS, `[[`, "", "tab")
v <- outer(seq_along(SEGMENTS), seq_along(SEGMENTS), Vectorize(function(i, j) if (i == j) NA else cramers_v(seg_mat[, i], seg_mat[, j])))
dimnames(v) <- list(labs, labs)
vt <- as.data.frame(v)
plot_ly(x = labs, y = labs, z = v, type = "heatmap", colors = c("#F3F7FB", "#1F4E79"), zmin = 0, zmax = 1,
        text = matrix(ifelse(is.na(v), "", fmt(v, 2)), nrow(v)), hoverinfo = "text",
        hovertemplate = "%{y}<br>%{x}<br>Cramer's V = %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
  base_layout(paste0("Strongest overlap: ", { m <- which(v == max(v, na.rm = TRUE), arr.ind = TRUE)[1, ]; paste0(labs[m[1]], " and ", labs[m[2]]) },
                     " (V = ", fmt(max(v, na.rm = TRUE), 2), ")"),
              "Cramer's V between each pair of segments  |  0 = unrelated, 1 = the same split  |  blank = too few shared participants",
              xaxis = list(tickangle = -40, title = ""), yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed")) |>
  layout(margin = list(t = 120, l = 190, b = 150), height = 750)
```

### Continuous measures {.tabset}

The groupings above split numbers at a cut point. These charts keep the numbers whole and show how each one relates to emotion change (Spearman's rho, which does not assume a straight line).

```{r continuous, results = "asis"}
CONT <- list(
  list(tab = "First message length", var = "human_1_n_words_coded", label = "Words in the first message"),
  list(tab = "Participant turns", var = "n_human_turns", label = "Number of participant messages"),
  list(tab = "AI medications", var = "ai_n_meds", label = "Distinct medications the AI named"),
  list(tab = "AI reply length", var = "ai_total_words", label = "Total words the AI wrote"))
strength <- function(r) ifelse(is.na(r), "no estimate for the", ifelse(abs(r) < .1, "no", ifelse(abs(r) < .3, "a weak", ifelse(abs(r) < .5, "a moderate", "a strong"))))
cont_plot <- function(cv) {
  d <- dat |> mutate(x = .data[[cv$var]]) |> filter(!is.na(x))
  rho <- function(y) { ok <- !is.na(y); if (sum(ok) < MIN_GROUP_N) return(c(NA, NA, sum(ok)))
    ct <- safe(suppressWarnings(cor.test(d$x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))); c(ct$estimate %||% NA, ct$p.value %||% NA, sum(ok)) }
  rn <- rho(d$na_change); rp <- rho(d$pa_change)
  title <- paste0(cv$label, " had ", strength(rn[1]), " link with negative-affect change (rho = ", fmt(rn[1], 2), ") and ",
                  strength(rp[1]), " link with positive-affect change (rho = ", fmt(rp[1], 2), ")")
  sub <- paste0("n = ", rn[3], "  |  Spearman p = ", fmtp(rn[2]), " (negative), ", fmtp(rp[2]), " (positive)  |  descriptive, not corrected")
  mk <- function(y, col, nm) plot_ly(d, x = ~x, y = y, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", name = nm, hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(color = col, size = 10, line = list(color = "white", width = 1.5)),
    text = person_hover(d, nm, paste0(cv$label, ": ", d$x, "<br>", nm, ": ", fmts(y, 0))))
  subplot(mk(d$na_change, "#1F4E79", "Negative affect change"), mk(d$pa_change, "#9DC3E6", "Positive affect change"),
          nrows = 1, shareY = TRUE, titleX = TRUE, margin = 0.05) |>
    base_layout(title, sub, showlegend = FALSE,
      annotations = list(
        list(text = "<b>Negative affect change</b>", xref = "paper", x = 0.225, xanchor = "center", yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 12, color = INK)),
        list(text = "<b>Positive affect change</b>", xref = "paper", x = 0.775, xanchor = "center", yref = "paper", y = 1.02, yanchor = "bottom", showarrow = FALSE, font = list(size = 12, color = INK))),
      xaxis = list(title = cv$label, gridcolor = "#E6E9EE"), xaxis2 = list(title = cv$label, gridcolor = "#E6E9EE"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Change (after minus before)", zeroline = TRUE, zerolinecolor = "#9AA3AF", gridcolor = "#E6E9EE"))
}
child <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(CONT), function(i) c(paste0("#### ", CONT[[i]]$tab), "", "```{r}", sprintf("cont_plot(CONT[[%d]])", i), "```", "")))
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = child, quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()), sep = "\n")
```

### AI said vs. recalled {.tabset}

Each chart compares what the AI actually wrote (hand-coded from the conversation) with what the participant later reported in the survey. Agreement shows how accurately people remember the AI's advice. The medication questions (G2, G3) asked about the most recent time an AI named a medication, which may not be the same conversation.

```{r recall, results = "asis"}
recode_e2 <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("5", "6") | str_detect(t, "clearly recommended|strongly urged") ~ "Clear or strong recommendation",
  t %in% c("3", "4") | str_detect(t, "gently suggested|possible actions") ~ "Gentle suggestion or options",
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "did not recommend|wait it out") ~ "No action or wait it out",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Clear or strong recommendation", "Gentle suggestion or options", "No action or wait it out")) }
recode_g2 <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t == "2" | str_detect(t, "^yes") ~ "Recalled other medications",
  t == "1" | str_detect(t, "only named one") ~ "Recalled only one",
  t == "3" | str_detect(t, "know") ~ "Don't know",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Recalled other medications", "Recalled only one", "Don't know")) }
recode_g3 <- function(x) { t <- lc(x); factor(case_when(
  t %in% c("4", "5") | str_detect(t, "favorable|clearly recommended") ~ "Favorable",
  t == "3" | str_detect(t, "neither") ~ "Neutral",
  t %in% c("1", "2") | str_detect(t, "against|discouraging") ~ "Discouraging",
  t == "6" | str_detect(t, "know") ~ "Don't know",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_), levels = c("Favorable", "Neutral", "Discouraging", "Don't know")) }
ai_med_group <- factor(case_when(dat$ai_n_meds >= 2 ~ "AI named 2+ medications", dat$ai_n_meds == 1 ~ "AI named one",
                                 dat$ai_n_meds == 0 ~ "AI named none"), levels = c("AI named 2+ medications", "AI named one", "AI named none"))
RECALL <- list(
  list(tab = "Action recommendation", st = cat_stats(bin_lab(dat$ai_refers_professional, "AI referred to a professional", "No referral"),
         recode_e2(coalesce(dat$action_ai_rec_self, dat$action_ai_rec_other)), "Clear or strong recommendation"),
       verb = "recalled a clear or strong recommendation", short = "clear or strong", q = "E2: how strongly the AI recommended action"),
  list(tab = "Other medications", st = cat_stats(ai_med_group, recode_g2(dat$med_alternatives), "Recalled other medications"),
       verb = "recalled the AI naming other medications", short = "recalled others", q = "G2: whether the AI named other medication options"),
  list(tab = "Medication framing", st = cat_stats(bin_lab(dat$ai_recommends_med, "AI recommended a medication", "Did not recommend one"),
         recode_g3(dat$med_framing), "Favorable"),
       verb = "recalled the AI as favorable toward the medication", short = "favorable", q = "G3: how the AI talked about the medication"))
recall_plot <- function(rc) {
  st <- rc$st; lv <- levels(st$data$cat)
  cols <- setNames(c("#1F4E79", "#4A86C5", "#9DC3E6", GRAY)[seq_along(lv)], lv)
  if ("Discouraging" %in% lv) cols["Discouraging"] <- NEG_COLOR
  if ("No action or wait it out" %in% lv) cols["No action or wait it out"] <- NEG_COLOR
  unit_plot(st, cols, "Participant recalled", pct_title(st, rc$verb, "Recalled"),
            paste0(test_line(st, "Fisher's exact", corrected = FALSE), "  |  survey item ", rc$q),
            function(r) paste0("<b>", round(r$pct_target), "% ", rc$short, "</b><br>n = ", r$n),
            function(d) paste0("Recalled: <b>", d$cat, "</b>"))
}
child <- unlist(lapply(seq_along(RECALL), function(i) c(paste0("#### ", RECALL[[i]]$tab), "",
  "```{r}", sprintf("recall_plot(RECALL[[%d]])", i), "```", "", "```{r}", sprintf("cat_table(RECALL[[%d]]$st)", i), "```", "")))
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = child, quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()), sep = "\n")
```

```{r segment-tabs, results = "asis"}
    child <- c(

      "#### Who felt calmer", "", "```{r}", sprintf("calmer_plot(RES[[%d]]$calmer)", i), "```", "",

      goal_block)
    cat(knitr::knit_child(text = child, quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()), sep = "\n")
  }
}
```
